Abbassa il livello, premi REC sul deck e: Lower the level, press REC on the deck and use a short test. The tone starts only by pressing the button.
Acquisisci e ascolta il master: Acquire and listen to the master
Acquisizione del ritorno dalla piastra: Acquisition of the return from the deck
Adatto il livello ai picchi e al profilo: Adjust level to peaks and profile after NR…
Adatto il livello prima dell’encoder NR…: Adjust the level before the NR encoder…
Aggiungi un effetto stereo al master. Vi: Add a stereo effect to the master. It is applied after EQ and compression, before NR encoding. For now VST3s are supported, with generic controls.
Al termine ferma REC e riavvolgi il nast: When finished, stop REC and rewind the tape.
Alcune bande sono deboli o instabili: il: Some bands are weak or unstable: the profile will limit the correction.
Allineo i marcatori e misuro frequenze,: I align the markers and measure frequencies, levels, noise and channels.
Analizzo livelli, frequenze e rumore…: I analyze levels, frequencies and noise…
Annota le condizioni della prova. Questi: Record the test conditions. These notes stay with the project and do not replace the automatic measurement.
Collega LINE OUT a un ingresso stereo e: Connect LINE OUT to a stereo input and check the return without creating a software feedback loop.
Il clipping è nella cattura LINE OUT → s: Clipping is occurring in the LINE OUT → interface capture. Reduce that level by at least {0} dB. REC LEVEL does not correct this stage; use the deck's output or an attenuator if the interface has fixed gain.
Riduci il livello di registrazione di ci: Reduce the recording level by about {0} dB. Lower REC LEVEL on the deck or the digital level sent from the source, then repeat the test. Suggested peak ceiling: {1} dBFS.
Scegli frequenza, livello e uscita verso: Choose frequency, level and output to the recorder.
Se la scheda audio non ha un controllo d: If the audio interface has no gain control, use REC LEVEL for the tape and the deck's output or an attenuator for the return.
Anteprima grafica · Audio, importazione: Graphical Preview · Audio, import and export are available in the desktop app.
Applica alle registrazioni e all’ascolto: Applies to recordings and listening to the master
Applica un guadagno comune per conservar: Applies a common gain to preserve differences between tracks.
Apri Audio dalla barra della Mixtape per: Open Audio from the Mixtape bar to listen to the strongest passages. LUFS normalization respects peak margin; dynamics is optional.
Apri Audio → Plugin VST3 e premi Carica: Open Audio → VST3 Plugin and press Load to authorize the plugin in this session
Apri l’app desktop per usare questa funz: Open the desktop app to use this feature. In the browser you can explore the interface with demo data.
Ascolta il lato. Per registrare, premi R: Listen to the side. To record, press REC on the deck, then REC here.
Listen to a passage and adjust the master. The original files remain intact.
Audio e progetti restano sul computer. I: Audio and projects remain on your computer. Projects save file references: keep the sources or relink them after moving them.
Audio in uscita. A fine lato ferma il de: Audio out. At the end of the side stop the deck.
Avvicina il livello medio dei brani al t: Brings the average level of the tracks closer to the RMS target.
Avvicina il volume percepito dei brani a: Brings the perceived volume of tracks closer to the LUFS target.
Avvio non riuscito. Controlla il messagg: Startup failed. Check the error message and the selected output.
Bassi profondi e alte in evidenza, con u: Deep bass and high treble in test, with a slight cut in the mid-bass.
Basso e cassa più presenti, medi leggerm: More present bass and kick, slightly scooped mids and a little attack on the guitars.
Biglietto da concerto, perforazioni e de: Concert ticket, perforations and backstage-pass details.
Bilancia i lati · rispetta i blocchi: Balance the sides · respect the blocks
Buffer ingresso saturo: acquisizione int: Input buffer saturated: acquisition interrupted, repeat the test.
Cali di segnale nella prova: possibile d: Signal drops in the test: possible dropout or chain instability.
Campioni prossimi al fondo scala: L: Samples close to full scale: L
MixtapeForge: uscita audio verso il deck: MixtapeForge: audio output to the deck
Clipping digitale: picchi brevi entro la: Digital clipping: short spikes within the tolerance of 1 ms per channel. These peaks do not block the EQ; for a more precise measurement repeat with a lower input gain.
Clipping digitale: superata la tolleranz: Digital clipping: tolerance of 1 ms per channel exceeded. Lower the card's input gain and repeat the test.
Coda finale · attendi la fine: Final queue · wait for the end
Codifica NR Type B dell’intero lato…: NR Type B coding of the entire side…
Codifica NR: uscita saturata; riduci il: NR coding: output saturated; reduce the level before the encoder
Collega LINE OUT a un ingresso stereo. I: Connect LINE OUT to a stereo input. The return is not sent back to the output: no software feedback loop.
Collega LINE OUT del deck all’ingresso s: Connect the deck's LINE OUT to the input selected in Settings. Press REC on the deck for a test run. Acquisition up to 60 seconds; comparison on the first 30, with automatic alignment within ±10 seconds.
Collega LINE OUT della piastra all’ingre: Connect the LINE OUT of the deck to the stereo input of the card.
Collega l’uscita della scheda a LINE IN: Connect the output of the card to the LINE IN of the deck. Use the tape to test, turn off Dolby/NR and take the tape past the initial unrecordable stretch.
Con Type B nell’app: registra con NR del: With Type B in the app: record with deck NR OFF, then listen to the cassette with Dolby B ON. Even activating it on the deck while recording would apply the encoding twice.
Conferma manuale, non certificazione di: Manual confirmation, not measurement certification. Changing the output requires a new check.
Confermo manualmente collegamenti e live: I manually confirm links and levels
Confronto non affidabile: segnale troppo: Unreliable comparison: signal too weak or not correlateable. Use the same music and repeat the capture.
Conserva i livelli originali e il guadag: Preserves the original levels and manual gain of each track.
Check the audio output and try again.
Crea un profilo dalla prova e riutilizza: Create a profile from the test and reuse it with the same deck, tape and adjustments. The selection resets the test frequency.
Creare un nuovo progetto? Puoi recuperar: Create a new project? You can recover your changes with Undo.
Creazione bloccata: risolvi gli avvisi s: Creation blocked: resolve test quality warnings and re-capture.
Device disconnected or stream error. Stop the deck.
Provision applied. You can cancel it.
Distorsione e compressione ai diversi li: Distortion and compression at different levels
Distribuisci i brani sui lati: Distribute the tracks on the sides
Dopo l’allineamento mantieni fissi volum: After alignment keep the computer volume, interface output and REC LEVEL fixed. Record the encoded master without adding EQ, normalization or compression after encoding. If the levels are not aligned, playback may sound too closed or bright.
Encoder Type B assente dal pacchetto del: Type B encoder missing from app package
Esporta PDF o SVG con tracklist sincroni: Export PDF or SVG with synced tracklist. Print at 100% and test the 50mm bar.
FFT 2048 punti: frequenza e HD3 sono ind: FFT 2048 points: frequency and HD3 are indicative on stable tone. For automatic sequencing and profiling use Calibration.
Fai prima una breve registrazione di pro: Make a short test recording first and listen to it again with Dolby B active. The preview in the app is still encoded: it does not represent the decoded listening to the cassette. Compatibility with a real deck is not yet verified.
Fasce magnetiche, indice A/B e filetti d: Magnetic stripes, an A/B index and blank-tape label rules.
Ferma REC sulla piastra. Riavvolgi prima: Stop REC on the deck. Rewind before the start marker, then capture the replay.
Ferma REC, lascia Dolby/NR disattivato e: Stop REC, leave Dolby/NR off and rewind before starting the test. Start capture here, then press PLAY on the deck. Capture stops on its own after the end marker. You can also stop it manually.
File troppo grande per il prototipo (512: File too large for prototype (512 MiB PCM per source). Divide the file into tracks.
Fondo elevato: le misure delle bande deb: High background: weak band measurements may include a lot of noise.
Forma d’onda dell’ultima finestra acquis: Waveform of the last acquired window
Formato o durata del master NR inattesi: Unexpected NR master format or duration
Formato o durata del master VST3 inattes: Unexpected format or length of VST3 master
Frequenza usata per registrare la prova: Frequency used to record the test
Geometrie Memphis, retini, zig-zag e col: Memphis geometry, dot patterns, zigzags and eighties pop colours.
Griglia da amplificatore, coni e fulmine: Amplifier grille, speaker cones and a lightning bolt: a rock poster.
Hai acquisito con un altro programma? Us: Did you acquire with another program? Use a stereo WAV with both markers, maximum 3 minutes.
I grigi sono applicati anche al PDF e al: Greys are also applied to PDF and SVG. To save ink choose B/W Archive.
I meter mostrano l’audio digitale. Contr: Meters show digital audio. Also check the levels on the deck.
I plugin sono disponibili nell’app deskt: Plugins are available in the desktop app.
I valori indicano il guadagno di ciascun: The values ​​indicate the gain of each filter; the curve shows the combined result of the bands. EQ applies to the entire master. Turn it off to compare without losing your adjustments. Rises may require master attenuation to comply with the true peak limit.
Il DSP ha prodotto un campione non finit: The DSP produced an unfinished sample
Il WAV contiene valori audio non validi: The WAV contains invalid audio values
Il WAV include trim, gap, transizioni e: The WAV includes trims, gaps, transitions and project processors. The reference tone is exported separately.
Il confronto richiede master e ritorno i: Comparison requires internal float32 stereo master and return
Il device non supporta questo master ste: The device does not support this floating-point stereo master at the chosen frequency. Change project or device frequency.
Il fit non può conservare la posizione d: Fit cannot maintain the location of all locked tracks
Il fit non trova spazio con questi vinco: The fit has no place with these constraints. Increase duration or reduce gaps; no tracks have been removed.
Il fondo cambia durante la prova: confro: The background changes during the test: compare the measurements with caution.
Il limite true peak ha precedenza: dopo: True peak limit takes precedence: after EQ and compression the master can be attenuated.
Il master intermedio supera il limite RI: The intermediate master exceeds the RIFF limit of 4 GiB. Reduce side frequency or duration.
Il nastro sta avanzando. L’audio parte d: The tape is running. The audio starts after the countdown; Stop cancels the departure.
Il plugin non risponde: tempo limite sup: The plugin does not respond: time limit exceeded
Il plugin non è stato elaborato: verific: The plugin has not been processed: check format, architecture and manufacturer authorization
Il profilo richiede il master interno st: The profile requires the internal float32 stereo master.
Il profilo viene salvato nella libreria: The profile is saved in the local library and in the project. To confirm the improvement, record and listen to a musical passage. By changing tape or adjustments, it creates a new profile.
Il profilo «{0}» è stato misurato con {1: The profile «{0}» was measured with {1}. Select that output or disable the profile in Calibration.
Il progetto è stato modificato da un’alt: This project was changed by another instance. Reopen it or save under a different name.
Il programma supera la capacità utilizza: The program exceeds the usable capacity of the side
Il testo sulle fasce colorate usa automa: Text on colored bands automatically uses black or white to remain legible.
Importa WAV, FLAC, MP3, AAC/M4A, AIFF o: Import WAV, FLAC, MP3, AAC/M4A, AIFF or OGG. Sort the tracks on sides A and B and check the time left. Select a track to adjust cuts, fades and final pause.
Importa i tuoi file audio. Per provare i: Import your audio files. To try out the controls you can load a demo with four short synthetic tracks.
Importa la tua musica o sposta qui un br: Import your music or move a track from the other side here.
Importa un WAV stereo tra 32 e 192 kHz: Import a stereo WAV between 32 and 192 kHz
Impossibile mantenere l'ordine senza sup: Unable to maintain order without exceeding capacity
Impossibile rispettare i limiti di picco: Failed to meet peak and profile limits after eight NR attempts. Reduce level before encoding; the NR reference remained unchanged.
Impossibile salvare il profilo nella lib: Failed to save profile to local library
Imposta la capienza del nastro e gli spa: Set the tape capacity and spaces between tracks.
Indica i dispositivi e i controlli realm: Indicates the devices and controls actually used during the test. Your current computer settings may be different. The profile does not set physical knobs and does not calibrate Dolby.
Indice A/B e righe sottili: essenziale,: A/B index and fine rules: simple and light on ink.
Indice a righe, caratteri dattiloscritti: Ruled index, typewritten lettering and adhesive tape.
Installa il plugin nella cartella VST3 s: Install the plugin into the system or user's standard VST3 folder
L'ascolto richiede un master interno flo: Listening requires an internal float32 master
La coda aggiunge tempo alla fine del lat: The queue adds time to the end of the side. Increase it if the delay repeats are cut.
La compressione indica quanto il livello: Compression indicates how much the level rises less than expected. HD3 measures the third harmonic of the tone; indicative values, not certified MOL.
La durata reale può variare. Il margine: Actual duration may vary. The margin leaves space before the physical end of the tape.
La frequenza del progetto differisce da: The project frequency differs from the profile frequency. Select the profile again in Calibration or deactivate it.
La prova non è abbastanza affidabile per: The test is not reliable enough to create a profile. Fix blocking warnings and try again.
La prova può durare al massimo 3 minuti: The test can last a maximum of 3 minutes
La scaletta segue i lati A/B. Questi tem: The playlist follows sides A/B. These templates contain up to 15 tracks; texts that are too long are shortened.
La sequenza di prova non usa EQ, compres: The test sequence does not use mixtape EQ, compression or NR.
La sequenza è incompleta. Riporta il nas: The sequence is incomplete. Return the tape to the beginning of the test and record the entire sequence again.
La sorgente è cambiata: {0}. Ricollega i: The source has changed: {0}. Relink the file to analyze it again.
La tracklist segue i due lati. Aggiungi: The tracklist follows the two sides. Add a dedication and print at 100%.
La tua piastra registra già in Dolby B?: Does your deck already record in Dolby B? Leave «No NR encoding» here and activate Dolby B on the deck. If you choose Type B in the app, the encoding is applied to the master instead.
Lascia margine ai picchi. Il segnale d’i: Leave margin for peaks. The input signal is not sent back to the output.
Le misure descrivono registrazione e rip: Measures describe recording and playback together. The profile limits uncertain corrections; it is not an independent calibration of the deck.
Le modifiche si ascoltano preparando di: The changes are listened to by preparing the master again. The original files remain intact.
Lettere ritagliate, carta strappata e re: Cut-out letters, torn paper and photocopy dot patterns.
Lettura del master interrotta. Ferma il: Master reading interrupted. Stop the deck.
Limiti di pilotaggio digitale per questa: Digital drive limits for this chain, with 1.5 dB of margin from the last reliable tone. The master controls them by frequency after the EQ and, if active, after Dolby. They are not certified magnetic flux or MOL values.
Lo spettro apparirà quando avvii l’acqui: The spectrum will appear when you start the acquisition.
L’acquisizione conserva l’audio original: Capture preserves the original audio of the input.
L’app usa CoreAudio su macOS, WASAPI su: The app uses CoreAudio on macOS, WASAPI on Windows and ALSA on Linux. Select the output and input of your sound card.
L’attenuazione include il margine stimat: Attenuation includes the estimated profile margin for the frequencies present in the master.
L’audio nativo è disponibile nell’app de: Native audio is available in the desktop app.
L’uscita selezionata deve supportare l’a: The selected output must support stereo audio at the chosen frequency. If it is not compatible, the app reports the problem before starting playback.
Manca la fine della prova: The end of the test is missing
Mantieni l’ordine · scegli il cambio lat: Maintain order · choose to switch sides

Media degli spettri rilevati durante l’a: Average of the spectra detected during acquisition.
Meno accumulo nei medio-bassi e una liev: Less buildup in the mid-bass and a slight presence for strings and vocals.
Nessun VST3 trovato. Installa un effetto: No VST3 found. Install an effect in the standard VST3 folder, then search again.
Nessun calo oltre 3 dB nelle finestre mi: No drops over 3 dB in measured windows
Nessun tono · misura del rumore di fondo: No tone · measurement of background noise
Nessuna attenuazione NR fissa. Se la cod: No fixed NR attenuation. If the encoding exceeds the peak limit, the app reduces the level before the codec and re-encodes the side. No normalization after NR.
Nessuna uscita audio. Apri Impostazioni: No audio output. Open Settings and update devices.
Do not stop before the end marker. Use WAV to record with another player. The signal is for measurement, it does not follow the settings of the mixtape.
Non riesco ad analizzare questa prova. C: I can't parse this test. Check the error message and repeat the capture or import another WAV.
Non tutte le frequenze hanno un limite s: Not all frequencies have an estimable limit: no limit is invented for uncertain measurements.
Ogni traccia deve appartenere a un lato: Each track must belong to one side
Ora puoi fermare PLAY sulla piastra e an: Now you can stop PLAY on the deck and analyze the test.
Per bassi troppo invadenti: −1 dB a 63 H: For too intrusive bass: −1 dB at 63 Hz, −2 dB at 125 and 250 Hz, −1 dB at 500 Hz.
Per dare risalto alla voce nel mix: +1 d: To make vocals stand out in the mix: +1 dB at 1 and 4 kHz, +1.5 dB at 2 kHz. It also involves the instruments in these bands.
Per piatti e alte troppo brillanti: −1 d: For cymbals and highs that are too bright: −1 dB at 4 kHz and −2 dB at 8 and 16 kHz. It is not a reduction in tape hiss.
Per registrare: premi REC sulla piastra,: To record: press REC on the deck, then REC here.
Per un suono aggressivo nei medio-alti:: For an aggressive sound in the mid-highs: −1 dB at 2 kHz and −2 dB at 4 kHz.
Per un suono magro: +1,5 dB a 63 e 125 H: For a lean sound: +1.5 dB at 63 and 125 Hz. Leave mids and highs unchanged.
Per una sorgente poco brillante: +1,5 dB: For a lackluster source: +1.5 dB at 8 kHz and +1 dB at 16 kHz. It does not automatically correct the cassette response.
Per usare questo profilo seleziona l’usc: To use this profile select the output
Picchi fuori scala: riduci il guadagno e: Peaks off scale: reduce gain and recalculate.
Più peso a basso e cassa, meno medio-bas: More weight in the bass and kick, less mid-bass and a slight increase in the voice.
Plugin caricato. Prepara il lato per asc: Plugin loaded. Prepare the side to listen to the result.
Plugin non disponibile: installalo o sel: Plugin not available: install or select it again
Poco contrasto tra testo e fondo: scegli: Low contrast between text and background: choose a lighter or darker text.
Porta il picco di ogni brano al limite s: Brings the peak of each track to the chosen limit.
Posizione dei controlli e note · facolta: Location of controls and notes · optional
Premi Carica plugin per verificarlo e mo: Press Load plugin to check it and show the controls. Saved settings are retained if the plugin matches.
Premi REC sulla piastra, poi Avvia prova: Press REC on the deck, then Start Test. After 3…2…1 the automatic sequence starts.
Press REC on the deck, then Start test: the audio starts after 3…2…1. Leave the output volume and REC LEVEL fixed until the end. The sequence goes up to −3 dBFS peak: start with a moderate volume.
Premi REC sulla piastra, poi REC qui: l’: Press REC on the deck, then REC here: the audio starts after 3 seconds
Prepara il master, allinea il deck e pre: Prepare the master, align the deck and press REC physically. Start the output, then turn the tape at the end of the side.
Prepara se necessario e ascolta il lato: Prepare if necessary and listen to the side from the beginning
Preparazione non riuscita. Controlla il: Preparation failed. Check the error message and try again.
Preparazioni, esportazioni e avvii audio: Preparing, exporting and playing audio on this computer.
Prima calibra la piastra per il nastro s: First calibrate the deck for the chosen tape, if it allows it. For software encoding, verified alignment with a non-encoded tone is required, following the Dolby reference provided in the deck manual. The tone level is set separately: 0 dBFS of the codec is not an indication to be reached on the deck meter. Tone frequency and meter indication depend on the model: the 0 dB of the meter does not necessarily coincide with the Dolby reference.
Prima di registrare un lato completo, co: Before recording a complete side, check the output, levels and NR setting with a short test. During REC, searching and skipping between tracks are blocked.
Profilo della prova precedente: massimo: Previous test profile: maximum ±3 dB. Run the new extended test to get the conservative profile and frequency limits.
Profilo di registrazione non valido o no: Recording profile invalid or inconsistent with the measurement.
Profilo precedente · la nuova prova este: Previous profile · new extended test adds caution, stability and frequency limits
Profilo prudente della prova estesa · {0: Cautious extended test profile · {0}/5 frequency limits available
Profilo prudente: metà correzione, massi: Cautious profile: half correction, maximum ±1.5 dB. No deep bass boost or 16 kHz recovery; the uncertain bands remain unchanged.
Profilo salvato e attivo. Confermalo con: Profile saved and active. Confirm this with a musical recording; you can cancel the activation.
Project in use from another save. Please try again in a moment.
Progetto salvato con riferimenti ai file: Project saved with references to the original files
Prova incompleta o non valida: registra: Incomplete or invalid test: record the entire sequence, including the two markers
Prova precedente da 49 secondi: avvia la: Previous 49 second test: start the new sequence to also measure the high limits and stability.
Puoi salvare subito con il solo nome. Di: You can save immediately with just your name. Devices and frequency are pre-populated with the available settings: you can correct them if the test was done with other settings.
Questa EQ non regola il bias del deck. I: This EQ does not adjust the deck bias. The master is checked after all processing and, if necessary, turned down in volume to respect the true peak limit. Verify the result with a test recording.
Questa prova non calibra il Dolby e non: This test does not calibrate Dolby and does not measure bias, magnetic flux, absolute MOL or wow/flutter according to standards. To confirm a correction, record and compare a musical passage. If you change tape, REC LEVEL or connections, repeat the test.
Questo prototipo richiede ingresso float: This prototype requires float32 input from the driver
Qui trovi la preparazione dei master, gl: Here you will find the preparation of the masters, the audio starts and any interruptions. The log does not confirm that the deck recorded the tape.
Raccolgo progetto e sorgenti…: I collect the project and sources…
Registra la prova e crea un profilo per: Record the test and create a profile for your deck and tape.
Regola questo brano senza modificare il: Adjust this track without changing the original file.
Riferimento 1 kHz = 0 dB. Sotto la linea: Reference 1 kHz = 0 dB. Below the line, the signal is attenuated. Measurements include sound card, deck and tape.

Riferito al tono 315 Hz a −18 dBFS peak: Refers to the 315 Hz tone at −18 dBFS peak
Rimuovi dall’EQ musicale la curva della: Remove the old test curve from the music EQ, to avoid a double correction

Risposta misurata dei canali sinistro e: Measured response of the left and right channels
Ritorno troppo debole o canale assente:: Return too weak or channel absent: check cables and input gain.
Sblocca i brani per dividere mantenendo: Unlock tracks to split while maintaining order, or use constrained fit
Scala FM, indicatore di sintonia e grigl: FM dial, tuning pointer and portable-radio speaker grille.
Scegli A4, scala 100% e disattiva intest: Choose A4, scale 100% and turn off headers and footers. Check the 50mm mark on the first copy. PDF keeps fonts as vector paths; the SVG includes the fonts and retains the editable text.
Scegli un brano dal menu qui sopra. Se l: Choose a track from the menu above. If the list is empty, add the files to the Mixtape or upload the demo.
Scostamento di velocità elevato: verific: High speed deviation: Check deck transport.

Seleziona la lettera per registrarlo: Select the letter to record it
Select a track to listen to.
Separazione L/R insufficiente: controlla: Insufficient L/R separation: Check swapped channels, mono input or connections.
